intro.default: From responsible technology to the complete student journey — the programme connects the questions that matter most to international higher education.

default.title: Navigating the Technological Shift
default.text: AI, digitalisation, data and new tools for smarter internationalisation — with academic values and human judgement in focus.

default.title: Challenges of Internationalisation
default.text: Funding, safety, wellbeing and inclusion — removing barriers to meaningful international experiences for students and staff.

default.title: Global & Regional Partnerships
default.text: Strategic cooperation, European University alliances and equitable partnerships across global regions.

default.title: From Recruitment to Retention
default.text: The student journey end to end — admissions, support, employability, alumni relations and long-term success.
